newsitem.title: FRANCE: Trichet says now is time to invest in Europe - RFTV.
newsitem.headline: Trichet says now is time to invest in Europe - RFTV.

text.p: It would be wrong to wait for further cuts in European interest rates before deciding on new investments, Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet said on Tuesday.
"If anybody waits for further cuts in interest rates before deciding to invest ... it would certainly be a mistake," he told Reuters Financial Television.
He had been asked whether there was a good chance that the next movement in European interest rates would be upwards.
Trichet said he would only reply by noting that now was a good time for entrepreneurs to invest.
"We have a very low level of nominal and real rates, historically very low," he said. "This has also triggered a very low level of market rates."
On France in particular, he said the central bank had made it plain to householders and businesses that they should take advantage of what he called the buoyant situation.
"We have a good competitive position, we have good level of market interest rates, we have the prospect for growth in the medium and long term. It is time to invest," he said.
The Bank of France earlier on Tuesday shaved five percentage points from its intervention rate to 3.15 percent and took 15 points off the five-to-10 day rate to 4.60 percent.
